Crate labels and a demanding lull
The welfare officer flagged a question about supply orders, and the crew cheered
Travel notes and tail wags

The Companion Animal Travel Desk has had a busy, good-humored stretch, with careful checks, steady hands, and plenty of kind words for nervous travelers. <<FACT F037>> Staff kept the pet cabin tidy, matched carriers to the right service, and made sure every handoff felt calm and respectful.

<<FACT F036>> The ground team also moved with the kind of quiet rhythm that keeps the whole day on track. Travelers noticed the gentle pace, the clear updates, and the extra patience around each small comfort request. It all adds up to a smoother trip for pets and people alike.
